title: Constants
notes: bonus_divider is labelled in Calculator!G13 and read by every skill bonus cell as ROUND(level / Calculator!$G$14, 0).
race_blend_divisor is the /2 in Setup!Q6 — ROUNDUP(K6+N6,0)/2 — the only place the sheet blends two races. The sheet has no label for it; the name is ours.
These four match the seed constants a fresh ruleset already ships with, so importing this fragment over a fresh configuration replaces like with like.

TICKET-RES-02 makes points_per_level load-bearing: the stat point budget is now derived as level × points_per_level, matching Charactersheet!E17 (level × points_per_level − points_spent). The flat Configuration.mainSkillPointBudget it replaces was never sheet data, so nothing was lost from this fragment when it was deleted.
The sheet has no starting_points cell — whether a fresh character gets a bonus pool on top of level 1's is unanswered there, so nothing is invented here and level 1's budget is the starting budget.

constants.name: bonus_divider
constants.description: How many skill levels are worth one point of bonus. Lower makes skills matter more.

constants.name: apt_value
constants.description: Speed needed per attack per turn. Lower gives everyone more attacks at the same Speed.

constants.name: points_per_level
constants.description: Skill points a character receives for each level gained.

constants.name: race_blend_divisor
constants.description: What a blended base is divided by when a character has more than one race.
